reviewType: assistant inspection, not a human review

findings.firstRunProblem: The response said low-confidence observations were included in the 46 count, contradicting deterministic context.
findings.change: Prompt explicitly excludes low confidence from countLast24h as well as the attention band.
findings.revisedObservation: The response now identifies the 46 count as nominal or high confidence. Its nearest-observation timestamp wording still needs review because the tool exposes a source-wide newest timestamp.

findings.firstRunProblem: The response interpreted zero placeholder fields as no recorded observations despite provider unavailability.
findings.change: Prompt forbids interpreting zero values for stale, unavailable or unknown context.
findings.revisedObservation: The response says the zero count cannot be read as no activity and retrieval time is unknown.

findings.firstRunProblem: Provider delivery was much faster than playback. Estimated audio queues exceeded the existing 20-second client cap.
findings.change: Queued audio is bounded to 120 seconds including each incoming chunk. Tests cover an 80-second burst, stop and over-limit cleanup.

releaseDecision: Keep human-review and hosted-browser gates open
